learner_operation: Solve for two scalar coefficients in a linear combination of two three-dimensional vectors, check all three component equations, and select the coefficient sum or No solution.

fixed_features.justification: Every captured task and canonical example asks the sum; different target operations would change the response task.
This is the observed checking-consistency workload; next lesson separately covers three coefficients.

fixed_features.feature: Finite source coefficient-column and substitution/elimination profiles
fixed_features.justification: Conservative moderate family preserves small arithmetic and source methods. Columns do not fix consistency, coefficient sum or correct numeric rank; every profile has controlled counterexamples. This is practice of the stated finite family, not a claim to all real systems.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change decisive target component to allow consistent or contradictory equations within each profile and label family.
answer_roles.observed: All14 profiles support both; relevant pairs update written checks and native accepted choice.

answer_roles.role: Coefficient sum and numeric key rank
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Vary bounded candidate translations and independent distractor gaps/rank, retaining x1+x2 as the response target.
answer_roles.observed: All four numeric ranks at fixed evidence in each controlled profile. Exact batch numeric keys10 and-2 occupy ranks1 and3.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Signs or names cannot replace consistency checks; changing irrelevant distractors must preserve truth.
answer_roles.observed: Exact batch has both outcomes under both sign cases. q-105165 distractor-only pair preserves10 across positive-only and mixed-sign banks. Finite label groups controlled separately.

coverage.result: 14/14 complete five-choice banks and ordered worked solutions reproduced, with verified q-105163 arithmetic correction; canonical sum-10 independently confirmed.

coverage.case: Both outcomes and four numeric ranks in every source coefficient profile
coverage.result: Observed before/after delivery; raw138->136 preserves both branches and ranks in all14 profiles.
5->5. Nonpositive banks:2 No solution and1 numeric; positive-only banks:1 No solution and1 numeric. Earlier sign strategy fails on a counterexample; second-largest succeeds1/5.

coverage.case: Fresh requested-size batch resampling and delivery
coverage.result: 21 and192 generated attempts respectively produce5 accepted records; each has all four sign/consistency cases after delivery. Retrying changes distribution but retains relevant cases.

counterfactuals.observed: Exact relationship holds in prompts, written checks, native grading of all five choices and actual UI questions6/7.
counterfactuals.justification: Source q-34568 checks contradiction; canonical e-4791 is a consistent c/d case. Labels are incidental.

counterfactuals.change: q-34568 seed509->510 with explicit parameters fixed.

counterfactuals.observed: Preserved in text, actual UI questions7/8 and native grading.
